s01.text: እኩለ ቀን አካባቢ ነበር፣ ከአንኮበር ስነሳ። አንድ የጀርባ ቦርሳ ብቻ ይዤ። አንድ ጓደኛዬ ሊሸኘኝ መጥቶ ነበር።
s01.subtitle: It was around midday when I left Ankober. Just one backpack. A friend had come to see me off.

subtitle_check.literal: It was around midday when I set out from Ankober. Carrying only one backpack. A friend of mine had come to see me off.

s02.text: እስከ ደብረ ብርሃን መንገዱ ፒስታ ነበር። ከዚያ በኋላ አስፋልት።
s02.subtitle: The road was gravel as far as Debre Birhan. After that, asphalt.

subtitle_check.literal: Up to Debre Birhan the road was gravel (unpaved). After that, asphalt.

s03.text: በአውቶቡሱ መስኮት በኩል ተቀምጬ ነበር። ውጪው ደንና ተራራ ነው። እይታው ድንቅ ነበር።
s03.subtitle: I sat by the window of the bus. Outside, forest and mountains. The view was amazing.

subtitle_check.literal: I was sitting by the window of the bus. Outside is forest and mountain. The view was wonderful.

s04.text: ላምበረት ስደርስ መሽቶ ነበር። ጓደኛዬ እየጠበቀኝ ነበር። ሰው በዝቷል፤ የሕንፃ መብራት፣ ብዙ መኪና።
s04.subtitle: It was night when I reached Lamberet. My friend was waiting for me. So many people, lights on the buildings, so many cars.

subtitle_check.literal: When I reached Lamberet, it had become evening. My friend was waiting for me. There were many people; building lights, many cars.

s06.text: አውቶቡስ ተራ ስንደርስ ደላሎች ከበቡን። «አልጋ ትፈልጋላችሁ?» ብዙ ነበሩ። ግራ ገባን። አንዱን መረጥን።
s06.subtitle: At Autobus Tera the brokers closed in on us. "Do you want a bed?" There were so many. We were confused. We picked one.

subtitle_check.literal: When we arrived at Autobus Tera, brokers surrounded us. "Do you want a bed?" They were many. We were confused. We chose one.

s07.text: ክፍሉ ባለ አንድ አልጋ ነበር። በጣም ጥሩ አይደለም፣ መጥፎም አይደለም። ንጹሕ ነበር።
s07.subtitle: The room had one bed. Not very good, not bad. It was clean.

subtitle_check.literal: The room was a one-bed room. Not very good, and not bad either. It was clean.

s08.text: ጠዋት ረጅም ሰልፍ ተሰልፈን ትኬት ቆረጥን።
s08.subtitle: In the morning we stood in a long queue and got the ticket.

subtitle_check.literal: In the morning we stood in a long line and bought tickets.

s09.text: ዛሬ ያንን ልጅ ባገኘው አንድ ነገር ብቻ እለዋለሁ፦ ኑረው።
s09.subtitle: If I met that boy today, I would tell him just one thing: experience it.

subtitle_check.literal: If I met that boy today, I would tell him only one thing: live it.
